case.sql:
with app_scoped as (
    select
        ap.*,
        an.species,
        an.site_id,
        an.intake_ts,
        an.adoption_fee,
        an.home_profile.kids_ok as kids_ok,
        an.home_profile.quiet_home as quiet_home
    from adoption_apps ap
    join shelter_animals an
      on an.animal_id = ap.animal_id
    where ap.submitted_ts >= timestamp '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
      and ap.status <> 'SPAM'
      and an.intake_ts < ap.submitted_ts
),
timed_apps as (
    select
        a.*,
        pw.window_id,
        date_trunc('DAY', a.submitted_ts) as app_day,
        datediff(a.submitted_ts, a.intake_ts) as days_since_intake,
        timestampdiff(HOUR, a.intake_ts, a.submitted_ts) as hours_since_intake,
        a.submitted_ts + interval '36' hour as review_due_ts,
        pw.close_ts + interval '7' day as grace_close_ts,
        transform(a.app_tags, x -> upper(x)) as norm_tags,
        filter(
            a.app_tags,
            x -> x is not null and length(x) > 3
        ) as long_tags,
        aggregate(
            a.app_tags,
            0,
            (acc, x) -> acc + length(x)
        ) as tag_chars,
        exists(a.app_tags, x -> x = 'priority') as is_priority
    from app_scoped a
    join placement_windows pw
      on pw.animal_id = a.animal_id
     -- Late applications receive a seven-day review grace period.
     and a.submitted_ts between pw.open_ts
                           and pw.close_ts + interval '7' day
),
status_pivot as (
    select *
    from (
        select region, status
        from timed_apps
    ) src
    pivot (
        count(*) as app_count
        for status in (
            'APPROVED' as approved_apps,
            'PENDING' as pending_apps
        )
    )
),
regional_rollup as (
    select
        region,
        species,
        grouping_id(region, species) as grp_lvl,
        count(*) as app_qty,
        count(*) filter (where status = 'APPROVED') as approved_qty,
        count(*) filter (where status = 'PENDING') as pending_qty,
        count(*) filter (where is_priority) as priority_qty,
        sum(
            case when array_size(long_tags) >= 2 then 1 else 0 end
        ) as multi_tag_qty,
        round(avg(coalesce(tag_chars, 0)), 2) as avg_tag_chars,
        round(avg(days_since_intake), 1) as avg_days_since_intake,
        max(hours_since_intake) as max_hours_since_intake,
        max(review_due_ts) as latest_review_due_ts
    from timed_apps
    group by rollup (region, species)
)
select
    r.region,
    r.species,
    r.grp_lvl,
    r.app_qty,
    r.approved_qty,
    r.pending_qty,
    r.priority_qty,
    r.multi_tag_qty,
    r.avg_tag_chars,
    r.avg_days_since_intake,
    r.max_hours_since_intake,
    r.latest_review_due_ts,
    coalesce(p.approved_apps, 0) as region_approved_qty,
    coalesce(p.pending_apps, 0) as region_pending_qty
from regional_rollup r
left join status_pivot p
  on p.region = r.region
 and r.grp_lvl = 0
where r.grp_lvl <> 2
order by
    r.grp_lvl desc,
    r.region nulls last,
    r.species nulls last
case.code:
from datetime import timedelta
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

app_scoped = (
    df_adoption_apps.alias("ap")
    .join(
        df_shelter_animals.alias("an"),
        F.col("an.animal_id") == F.col("ap.animal_id"),
    )
    .filter(
        (F.col("ap.submitted_ts") >= F.lit("2025-02-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("ap.status") != "SPAM")
        & (F.col("an.intake_ts") < F.col("ap.submitted_ts"))
    )
    .select(
        "ap.*",
        "an.species",
        "an.site_id",
        "an.intake_ts",
        "an.adoption_fee",
        F.col("an.home_profile.kids_ok").alias("kids_ok"),
        F.col("an.home_profile.quiet_home").alias("quiet_home"),
    )
)

timed_apps = (
    app_scoped.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_placement_windows.alias("pw"),
        (F.col("pw.animal_id") == F.col("a.animal_id"))
        & F.col("a.submitted_ts").between(
            F.col("pw.open_ts"),
            F.col("pw.close_ts") + timedelta(days=7),
        ),
    )
    .select(
        "a.*",
        "pw.window_id",
        F.date_trunc("DAY", F.col("a.submitted_ts")).alias("app_day"),
        F.datediff(F.col("a.submitted_ts"), F.col("a.intake_ts")).alias("days_since_intake"),
        F.expr("timestampdiff(HOUR, a.intake_ts, a.submitted_ts)").alias("hours_since_intake"),
        (F.col("a.submitted_ts") + timedelta(hours=36)).alias("review_due_ts"),
        (F.col("pw.close_ts") + timedelta(days=7)).alias("grace_close_ts"),
        F.transform(F.col("a.app_tags"), lambda x: F.upper(x)).alias("norm_tags"),
        F.filter(
            F.col("a.app_tags"),
            lambda x: x.isNotNull() & (F.length(x) > 3),
        ).alias("long_tags"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.col("a.app_tags"),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + F.length(x),
        ).alias("tag_chars"),
        F.exists(F.col("a.app_tags"), lambda x: x == "priority").alias("is_priority"),
    )
)

status_pivot = (
    timed_apps
    .select("region", "status")
    .groupBy("region")
    .pivot("status", ["APPROVED", "PENDING"])
    .agg(F.count(F.lit(1)))
    .select(
        "region",
        F.col("APPROVED").alias("approved_apps"),
        F.col("PENDING").alias("pending_apps"),
    )
)

regional_rollup = (
    timed_apps
    .rollup("region", "species")
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id("region", "species").alias("grp_lvl"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("app_qty"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "APPROVED", F.lit(1))).alias("approved_qty"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "PENDING", F.lit(1))).alias("pending_qty"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("is_priority"), F.lit(1))).alias("priority_qty"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.size(F.col("long_tags")) >= 2, F.lit(1)).otherwise(F.lit(0))
        ).alias("multi_tag_qty"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.coalesce(F.col("tag_chars"), F.lit(0))), 2).alias("avg_tag_chars"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("days_since_intake")), 1).alias("avg_days_since_intake"),
        F.max(F.col("hours_since_intake")).alias("max_hours_since_intake"),
        F.max(F.col("review_due_ts")).alias("latest_review_due_ts"),
    )
)

result = (
    regional_rollup.alias("r")
    .join(
        status_pivot.alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.region") == F.col("r.region")) & (F.col("r.grp_lvl") == 0),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(F.col("r.grp_lvl") != 2)
    .select(
        "r.region",
        "r.species",
        "r.grp_lvl",
        "r.app_qty",
        "r.approved_qty",
        "r.pending_qty",
        "r.priority_qty",
        "r.multi_tag_qty",
        "r.avg_tag_chars",
        "r.avg_days_since_intake",
        "r.max_hours_since_intake",
        "r.latest_review_due_ts",
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.approved_apps"), F.lit(0)).alias("region_approved_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.pending_apps"), F.lit(0)).alias("region_pending_qty"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("r.grp_lvl").desc(),
        F.col("r.region").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("r.species").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

case.sql:
WITH normalized_events AS (
    -- Keep identified usage in the reporting period and parse client properties.
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.acct_id,
        e.user_id,
        e.event_ts,
        CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        e.event_name,
        e.steps,
        from_json(e.props_json, 'client STRING, os STRING') AS client_props
    FROM product_usage_events e
    WHERE e.event_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND e.event_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
      AND e.user_id IS NOT NULL
),
step_usage AS (
    -- Flatten instrumented steps and retain the three product usage metrics.
    SELECT
        n.event_id,
        n.acct_id,
        n.user_id,
        n.event_ts,
        n.usage_date,
        n.client_props.client AS client,
        step.step_name,
        step.metric,
        step.qty
    FROM normalized_events n
    LATERAL VIEW explode(n.steps) AS step
    WHERE step.qty IS NOT NULL
      AND step.metric IN ('SESSIONS', 'ACTIONS', 'ERRORS')
),
matched_usage AS (
    -- Attribute steps to flags active at event time or in the seven-day lookback tail.
    SELECT
        s.acct_id,
        s.usage_date,
        s.user_id,
        s.client,
        r.flag_key,
        r.rollout_state,
        s.metric,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM step_usage s
    JOIN feature_flag_rollouts r
      ON r.acct_id = s.acct_id
     AND s.event_ts BETWEEN r.rollout_start AND r.rollout_end + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    WHERE r.rollout_state <> 'RETIRED'
    GROUP BY
        s.acct_id,
        s.usage_date,
        s.user_id,
        s.client,
        r.flag_key,
        r.rollout_state,
        s.metric
),
usage_pivot AS (
    -- Spread metric quantities into one column per usage measure.
    SELECT *
    FROM matched_usage
    PIVOT (
        SUM(total_qty)
        FOR metric IN (
            'SESSIONS' AS sessions,
            'ACTIONS' AS actions,
            'ERRORS' AS errors
        )
    )
),
account_context AS (
    -- Expose account struct fields, map preferences, and decoded profile details.
    SELECT
        a.acct_id,
        a.acct_name,
        a.plan_tier,
        a.settings.region AS region,
        a.settings.seat_limit AS seat_limit,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(element_at(a.billing_prefs, 'currency'), ''),
            'USD'
        ) AS billing_currency,
        from_json(
            a.profile_json,
            'team_name STRING, admin_email STRING'
        ) AS profile
    FROM subscription_accounts a
)
SELECT
    p.*,
    a.acct_name,
    COALESCE(a.profile.team_name, a.acct_name) AS team_label,
    a.plan_tier,
    COALESCE(a.region, 'UNSET') AS region,
    a.seat_limit,
    a.billing_currency,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(p.sessions, 0)
           + COALESCE(p.actions, 0)
           + COALESCE(p.errors, 0) = 0 THEN 'INACTIVE'
        WHEN COALESCE(p.errors, 0) > COALESCE(p.actions, 0) THEN 'AT_RISK'
        WHEN COALESCE(p.actions, 0) >= 8 THEN 'POWER_USE'
        ELSE 'STEADY_USE'
    END AS activity_band
FROM usage_pivot p
JOIN account_context a
  ON a.acct_id = p.acct_id
ORDER BY
    p.usage_date,
    p.acct_id,
    p.flag_key,
    p.user_id
case.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

normalized_events = (
    df_product_usage_events.alias("e")
    .filter(
        (F.col("event_ts") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("event_ts") < F.lit("2025-05-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & F.col("user_id").isNotNull()
    )
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "acct_id",
        "user_id",
        "event_ts",
        F.col("event_ts").cast("date").alias("usage_date"),
        "event_name",
        "steps",
        F.from_json(F.col("props_json"), "client STRING, os STRING").alias("client_props"),
    )
)

step_usage = (
    normalized_events.alias("n")
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "acct_id",
        "user_id",
        "event_ts",
        "usage_date",
        F.col("client_props.client").alias("client"),
        F.explode(F.col("steps")).alias("step"),
    )
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "acct_id",
        "user_id",
        "event_ts",
        "usage_date",
        "client",
        F.col("step.step_name").alias("step_name"),
        F.col("step.metric").alias("metric"),
        F.col("step.qty").alias("qty"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("qty").isNotNull() & F.col("metric").isin("SESSIONS", "ACTIONS", "ERRORS"))
)

matched_usage = (
    step_usage.alias("s")
    .join(
        df_feature_flag_rollouts.alias("r"),
        (F.col("r.acct_id") == F.col("s.acct_id"))
        & F.col("s.event_ts").between(
            F.col("r.rollout_start"),
            F.col("r.rollout_end") + F.expr("INTERVAL '7' DAY"),
        ),
        "inner",
    )
    .filter(F.col("r.rollout_state") != "RETIRED")
    .groupBy(
        F.col("s.acct_id").alias("acct_id"),
        F.col("s.usage_date").alias("usage_date"),
        F.col("s.user_id").alias("user_id"),
        F.col("s.client").alias("client"),
        F.col("r.flag_key").alias("flag_key"),
        F.col("r.rollout_state").alias("rollout_state"),
        F.col("s.metric").alias("metric"),
    )
    .agg(F.sum(F.col("s.qty")).alias("total_qty"))
)

usage_pivot = (
    matched_usage
    .groupBy("acct_id", "usage_date", "user_id", "client", "flag_key", "rollout_state")
    .pivot("metric", ["SESSIONS", "ACTIONS", "ERRORS"])
    .agg(F.sum("total_qty"))
    .withColumnRenamed("SESSIONS", "sessions")
    .withColumnRenamed("ACTIONS", "actions")
    .withColumnRenamed("ERRORS", "errors")
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        "usage_date",
        "user_id",
        "client",
        "flag_key",
        "rollout_state",
        "sessions",
        "actions",
        "errors",
    )
)

account_context = (
    df_subscription_accounts.alias("a")
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        "acct_name",
        "plan_tier",
        F.col("settings.region").alias("region"),
        F.col("settings.seat_limit").alias("seat_limit"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.nullif(F.element_at(F.col("billing_prefs"), F.lit("currency")), F.lit("")),
            F.lit("USD"),
        ).alias("billing_currency"),
        F.from_json(F.col("profile_json"), "team_name STRING, admin_email STRING").alias("profile"),
    )
)

result = (
    usage_pivot.alias("p")
    .join(account_context.alias("a"), F.col("a.acct_id") == F.col("p.acct_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "p.*",
        "a.acct_name",
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.profile.team_name"), F.col("a.acct_name")).alias("team_label"),
        "a.plan_tier",
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.region"), F.lit("UNSET")).alias("region"),
        "a.seat_limit",
        "a.billing_currency",
        F.when(
            (F.coalesce(F.col("p.sessions"), F.lit(0))
             + F.coalesce(F.col("p.actions"), F.lit(0))
             + F.coalesce(F.col("p.errors"), F.lit(0))) == 0,
            "INACTIVE",
        )
        .when(F.coalesce(F.col("p.errors"), F.lit(0)) > F.coalesce(F.col("p.actions"), F.lit(0)), "AT_RISK")
        .when(F.coalesce(F.col("p.actions"), F.lit(0)) >= 8, "POWER_USE")
        .otherwise("STEADY_USE")
        .alias("activity_band"),
    )
    .orderBy("p.usage_date", "p.acct_id", "p.flag_key", "p.user_id")
)
